Wednesday, August 5th | 6-8p

past.title: Cars and Coffee Norfolk Goes to Chesapeake | Aug 1st
past.body:
(1st Sat) Cars and Coffee Norfolk Goes to Chesapeake

Saturday, August 1st | 9-11am

Located at Greenbrier Mall, 1401 Greenbrier Pkwy., Chesapeake.

Monthly car meet on the 1st  Saturday of every month. All cars, motorcycles, bicycles, etc. welcome! Free coffee and doughnuts!

***UPDATE - New Location*** 

We're temporarily hosting our first Saturday events at Greenbrier Mall in Chesapeake. We will be in the lot behind the old Sears, at the back of the mall. As you enter, turn left and drive around the perimeter of the parking lot to the back where we'll be set up with the tent.

Please be respectful of the temporary location and help us keep the event going. ABSOLUTELY NO: Revving, burnouts, loud music. Be on your best behavior and respect the location.

past.title: Nerds & Horsepower | July 25th
past.body:
Nerds & Horsepower

Saturday, July 25th | Noon-6P

Located at St. George Brewing Company- 204 Challenger Way, Hampton, Va

Where geek culture meets car culture! Join us at St. George Brewing Company for an exciting community event filled with awesome vehicles, unique vendors, collectibles, food, brews, and fandom fun.

Explore a marketplace featuring artists, makers, collectibles, anime-inspired goods, pop culture merchandise, and more while checking out an incredible variety of cars and automotive builds. Whether you’re into horsepower, gaming, anime, comics, or just looking for a fun day out, there’s something for everyone to enjoy.

Car Showcase
Vendors & Artists
Nerd Culture & Collectibles
Food & Brews
Community & Fun

Cosplay Encouraged
Family Friendly
Free Admission

Gather your crew and come celebrate the perfect mix of fandoms and horsepower at Nerds & Horsepower!

Flyer designed by @kazarts

past.title: The Shine Showdown | July 18th
past.body:
The Shine Showdown

Saturday, July 18th | 10am-5pm

Located at 250 Visitor Center Dr Williamsburg, VA 23185

Move in day July 17th between 12noon-7pm, vehicle must have less than a 1/4 tank of gas.

The cost to register a Car/Bike is $35 and Vendor Spaces available for $150.

All vehicles and bikes welcomed. Car Show judging will be based on pre-registered vehicles.

Guest Speaker, DJ, and celebrity guest are invited.

The mission of the SHINE SHOWDOWN is to bring together automotive enthusiasts, businesses, and innovators to celebrate excellence in vehicle presentation, craftsmanship, and protection. We aim to create a high-energy, educational, and community-driven experience that elevates the standard of car culture in Virginia and beyond.

past.title: Classic Cruisers Saturday Night Cruz In | July 11th
past.body:
(Weekly) Classic Cruisers Saturday Night Cruz In Presented by Classic Cruisers Car Club

Saturday, July 11th | 4:30-8p

Located at Coastal Community Church, 101 Village Ave., Yorktown.

Mark your calendar to join us for our 1st Cruise-In. Cruz-Ins will be every Saturday from Apr 25 to Oct 24.

All years and types of vehicles are welcome – If you believe it’s cool, bring it in. We are asking for a $2.00 donation per vehicle. Please consider donating more – All proceeds go to charity. Vehicles are to be parked as directed by club personnel when necessary. No bicycles, skateboards, scooters, roller blades, or anything used in a manner that could injure people or damage vehicles are allowed in the participant parking area. Please do not touch vehicles without owners’ permission. Children under 12 must be accompanied by an adult. No horseplay is allowed with vehicles at any time. (Such as burn-outs, engine revving, car hopping, loud radios or other disruptive actions). Alcoholic beverages, illegal drugs, and firearms are prohibited. There are to be NO SALES within the participant parking area EXCEPT for pre-approved items where the sale benefits charity. We are guests here. So PLEASE either take your trash with you or use the receptacles provided. 

Listing is provided by our Partnership with Don Pablo presents Car Crazy in Tidewater!

past.title: Cars and Coffee Chesapeake | July 11th
past.body:
[2nd sat] Cars and Coffee Chesapeake

Saturday, July 11th | 8a-11a

Located at Everbowl - 1244 Greenbrier Pkwy #570, Chesapeake, VA 23320

Team Ultraspeed and Everbowl are teaming up to bring you the best Cars and Coffee meets in the area! Come hangout and help us close out the 2025 Car Season. We are collecting non-perishable goods this month for the Foodbank of Southwestern VA. Give Thanks, Give Food. Help us drive out hunger! We are also still collecting new kids pajamas to support Pajama Jams. Pajama Jams collects these items throughout the year in preparation for their important Annual Holiday Pajama Drive for Hampton Roads. Please drop off your donations at the Red Ultraspeed tent, you can write it off on your taxes! We are now a 501(C)3! You won't want to miss this, so mark your calendars and we'll see you there!
